title: Dispatch: 19.2.4 repair after Sol 19.2.4.4 S1 (attempt 3)
description: Repair PR #655 per Sol review eshyra-o9bd.19.2.4.4 S1 (read in full). This is the SECOND repair of the D2 delivery class (prior: 19.2.4.2 S2): the qualified ambiguous candidates are built in toolLookupRules.ts but every model transport drops error data. Close it as one class across ALL serializers: packages/core/src/model/agentSdkMcpClient.ts (~:165, MCP text AND structuredContent), model/anthropicNativeClient.ts (~:136), model/openaiNativeClient.ts (~:110), model/codexMcpHttpServer.ts (~:65), plus any other place a ToolResult failure is serialized for a provider (grep for code/message error projections; check the legacy fenced renderToolResults and executor delegates). Reconcile the neutral ModelToolResult failure type (model/client.ts ~:252) with ToolResult so optional failure data is part of the contract. Error-with-data must reach the provider with candidate identities, kind, source/locator and structured re-query data; success and error-without-data behaviour must stay unchanged; keep cap/overflow and error semantics. Do not move qualification into another undelivered field. Permanent evidence: extend the existing adapter/MCP tests with a generalized error-with-data transport invariant exercised through public adapter/MCP boundaries using actual ambiguous lookup results (Darkvision source-distinct passages; same-kind feature collisions such as Spellcasting/ASI), asserting the provider-side payload carries each shown candidate's identity and qualification; include an error-without-data control. Correct registry reasoning (display-name-qualification / F-22) to cite actual DM delivery. Report every serializer inspected in notes. Host memory: wait until pgrep -fc '^node .*verify-current-worktree' prints 0 or 1; npm run verify:worktree && git commit. Notes; close this bead. No push/PR.
